title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'hyphens' for Seamless Text Flow
tweet: Enhance #UI design & #UX by mastering CSS 'hyphens'! Prevent awkward gaps & improve readability in justified text. A small detail, huge impact. #CSSTypography #WebFonts
tip: For optimal readability and aesthetic balance, especially in justified or narrow columns, enable soft hyphens using the 'hyphens' property. Combine with the 'lang' attribute on your HTML or relevant elements for language-specific rules to ensure accurate hyphenation and prevent readability issues in different languages. This creates a much more pleasant reading experience.
